This section collects the reports on the wood provision ecosystem service accounts. A report can also be downloaded as a PDF from the

## Methods and results

[Wood Provision Ecosystem Service Accounts](methods/wood-provision/index.qmd)
: Describes how the actual flow, the sustainable flow and the overuse of wood provision are estimated and valued for the EU27 in 2000, 2006, 2012, 2018 and 2024, and presents the results.
